name: prisma-event-order-system
description: PEOS MVP with Clean Architecture over Google Workspace

scripts.build:apps-script: npm run clean && esbuild apps-script/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=apps-script/dist/code.js --footer:js="var __peos_onFormSubmit = globalThis.onFormSubmit; function onFormSubmit(e){ return __peos_onFormSubmit(e); }" && shx cp apps-script/appsscript.json apps-script/dist/appsscript.json
scripts.dev:apps-script: npm run clean && shx mkdir -p apps-script/dist && shx cp apps-script/appsscript.json apps-script/dist/appsscript.json && esbuild apps-script/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2019 --outfile=apps-script/dist/code.js --footer:js="var __peos_onFormSubmit = globalThis.onFormSubmit; function onFormSubmit(e){ return __peos_onFormSubmit(e); }" --watch
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:web
